{{Top}}
[[File:AT-AT_Fathead.png|thumb|right|210px|All Terrain Armored Transport]]
The '''AT-series''', also referred to as the '''All Terrain''' series, or the '''AT-series walker family''', vehicles were a series of [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], its subsidiaries [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], and [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]], and was most widely used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

{{Veh-stub}}
